I will do this small plot the way I know and the way women around me do when money is tight. The land is mine, so I will put household compost and old manure there, but I will not buy chemical fertilizer because this plot is too small and one bag costs too much for me. I will plant my local cuttings with the other crops I mix there, I will weed by hand, and I will wait for the rains because I do not have water to irrigate.
